items.difficulty_reason: For X -> Y -> Z of locally Noetherian spaces over S, coherent F on X, x over y over z with nonzero geometric stalk, the theorem equates: (1) F flat over Z at x and flat over the fibre Y_z at x, with (2) Y flat over Z at y and F flat over Y at x. The retained proof is written as the chart import: choose the scheme presentation of the chapter's flat-on-fibres-at-point lemma part (3) — surjective etale arrows identifying the situation with morphisms of schemes U -> V -> W, pulled-back sheaf a^*F and a point u — after which the definitions match the statement to More on Morphisms, theorem criterion-flatness-fibre-Noetherian verbatim. The reduction is spelled out (diagram, sheaf pullback, point choice), so the imported engine is the schemes theorem named to label. Retained author proof at lines 6053-6063.
